verdict.rationale: Klaviyo publishes a per-endpoint API reference (e.g., create_campaign, create_event) and ships its own Postman collection of pre-built requests and an importable spec, so runnable examples exist. However, running them happens in a third-party tool (Postman), and nothing shows the reference itself is interactive. Missing for 10: evidence of an in-browser interactive 'try it' console within the reference, documented runnable code examples on reference pages, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Make test calls using Postman’s UI tool with our collection of pre-built API requests.
Import the spec into your favorite API tool, such as Postman, to start interacting with our new APIs right away.
Creates a campaign given a set of parameters, then returns it.
Populate your test account with sample data to quickly explore our API and see how data is used in Klaviyo.
